Company Introduction

Established in Shanghai in 2005 by three movingand logistics enthusiastic professionals, SAE Asia was created in response tothe growing demands from individuals and small-medium sized businesses in Chinafor their moving and shipping needs. 
By understanding the challenges and difficultiesindividuals and small-medium businesses can face when dealing with biggercorporate or local companies, SAE Asia designed a solution that would providethe highest quality of service thanks to a team of devoted personnel and ataffordable rates. 
Now regarded as the #1 top choice in China by ourever-growing clientele, we are proud to continue our leadership for providinglow cost, reliable and service-oriented moving & shipping services. 

公司介绍

2005年, 三位具有丰富搬家和物流配送经验的专业人员，在上海创立SAE ASIA. 当时正值中国市场对货运和搬家服务的需求日益增多，尤其是个人及中小型公司，SAE ASIA就这样应运而生。
我们深知，个人和中小型公司在与国际大公司或本地公司商讨搬家事宜时, 要面临的挑战和困难, SAE ASIA的解决方案是, 组成一个有奉献精神的团队,以实惠的价格, 为客户提供高质量的服务。
随着我们客户群的壮大, 现我公司已成为中国搬家公司的首选, 我们以继续提供低价, 可靠的货运和搬家服务为荣。
